technology_name: Coir Fibre Root Trainers: Biodegradable Plant Nursery Container
problem_solved: Huge consumption of single-use plastic containers in forest nurseries causes massive plastic pollution, alongside issues like root coiling and transplant shock in traditional bags.
description: India's first Coir Fibre-Based Root Trainers (CRT) are developed from latex-sprayed coir mattress material as a fully biodegradable, eco-friendly alternative to plastic bags. Designed with four internal ridges and a 20mm drainage hole, these 150 cc containers promote healthy root architecture and prevent harmful root coiling. The units can be planted directly into the earth alongside the seedling, decomposing naturally over time.
applications:
• Mass adoption by state forest departments and municipal nurseries to meet plastic bans

• Commercial manufacturing by coir cooperatives and rural self-help groups

• Retail distribution in commercial horticulture, landscaping, and consumer home-gardening sectors

• Export market positioning as premium eco-friendly agricultural planting materials
